svg.title: Restore shell stdout while the child keeps its output file
svg.desc: Only the expanded Kernel Heap is shown. The SRAM layout and emulator host remain as in the first snapshot. PCB 1 for the shell points to its FileDescriptorTable and its contiguous eight-entry array. Each object and each path string has its own BlockHeader. Only entries 1, 3 and 6 have their path allocations expanded. STDIN, STDOUT, STDERR, FILE and FREE abbreviate FILE_DESCRIPTOR constants. Amber outlines mark changed entries. Other allocations, flags and offsets are omitted. Teal arrows follow stored pointers. Amber call boxes and arrows identify the calls and the descriptor entries or tables they change. Each outlined group contains one process's descriptors above and its copied paths below. PCB 2 and its independent descriptor allocations are expanded in the second row. Block letters and widths do not specify allocation order or sizes.

g.text: Kernel Heap · expanded · each path box is a separate copied string
